rows.grounds: fused compound adjective; internal members moon, fire, left, eye, bindu, nāda, maya (formed of); transcribed as one token
optative third singular active of root bhū

items.question: What becomes formed of moon-fire-left-eye-bindu-nāda for devotees of Tripureshani?
items.inference: The wish-granting jewel becomes constituted by moon-fire-left-eye-bindu-nāda.
uncertainties: Exact compound segmentation and grammatical gender are uncertain.
items.plain_english: It becomes formed of moon, fire, left eye, bindu, and nāda.
